description_zh: 调用ListVpcEndpoints接口，查询终端节点列表
name: ListVpcEndpoints

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the endpoints that you want to query.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/120468.html operation to obtain the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的终端节点所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/120468.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to have a token for the next query. Valid values:
If this is the first query or there is no next query, you do not need to specify this parameter.
If a next query exists, set the value to the NextToken value returned by the previous API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 1000. Default value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小。取值范围：1~1000。默认值：50
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The ID of the endpoint that you want to query
parameters.name: endpoint_id

parameters.help_en: The service name of the endpoint service associated with the endpoint that you want to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的终端节点关联的终端节点服务名称
parameters.name: service_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) to which the endpoint belongs
parameters.help_zh: 终端节点所属的专有网络
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en:
The endpoint type. Valid values:

Interface: interface endpoint.

Reverse: reverse endpoint.
GatewayLoadBalancer: Gateway Load Balancer endpoint (GWLBe). You can create a Gateway Load Balancer endpoint (GWLBe) to connect to a Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB) for load balancing
parameters.help_zh:
终端节点类型。取值：

Interface：表示接口终端节点。

Reverse：表示反向终端节点。
GatewayLoadBalancer：表示网关型负载均衡终端节点
parameters.name: endpoint_type

parameters.help_en:
The status of the endpoint. Valid values:

Creating: being created.

Active: available.

Pending: being modified.

Deleting: being deleted
parameters.help_zh:
终端节点状态，取值：

Creating：创建中。

Active：可用。

Pending：修改中。

Deleting：删除中
parameters.name: endpoint_status

parameters.help_en:
The endpoint connection status. Valid values:

Pending: being modified.

Connecting: connecting.

Connected: connected.

Disconnecting: disconnecting.

Disconnected: disconnected.

Deleting: being deleted.

ServiceDeleted: the corresponding endpoint service has been deleted
parameters.help_zh:
终端节点连接状态，取值：

Pending：修改中。

Connecting：连接中。

Connected：已连接。

Disconnecting：断开连接中。

Disconnected：未连接。

Deleting：删除中。

ServiceDeleted：终端节点对应的服务已删除
parameters.name: connection_status

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the instance. You can specify up to 20 tag keys. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
实例的标签键。最多支持20个标签键。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。

最多支持64个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the instance. You can specify up to 20 tag values. The tag value can be an empty string.

The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
实例的标签值。最多支持20个标签值。一旦传入该值，可以为空字符串。

最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The protocol version. Valid values:

IPv4: IPv4.
DualStack: dual-stack
parameters.help_zh:
协议版本。取值：

IPv4：IPv4类型。
DualStack：双栈类型
parameters.name: address_ip_version

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the endpoint service
parameters.help_zh: 终端节点服务所属的地域 ID
parameters.name: service_region_id
